response.original_title: (Faq-Tip!)How do I add multiple rooms on a Seabourn Cruise Line
response.overview: To add multiple rooms, book each cabin based on availability. You must call ☎️ +1-866-829-1280(US/Canada) or +44 (204) 586-5316 [UK] Seabourn Cruise Lines to request multiple cabins, especially if you want connecting or nearby rooms. ☎️ +1-866-829-1280(US/Canada) or +44 (204) 586-5316 [UK] A representative can check available cabin combinations and help arrange the reservations together. If you have already booked one cabin, ☎️ +1-866-829-1280(US/Canada) or +44 (204) 586-5316 [UK] provide your existing booking number when requesting another room to help keep your travel arrangements connected.
